description: Control loop: lockstep command lateness (in-process and remote barrier controllers, 10 Hz-10 kHz) and served paced asynchronous commands from an external process over the control socket (plan served-1ms: 1 ms page target = 1024 samples at 1 MS/s, timed with leads of 2, 4, 6, 8 and 12 ms and asap at 100 and 10 commands/s, then timed 8 ms and asap at 1000 commands/s), B2 base scene with 2 links (1 TX, 2 RX); TX streams generated and RX kept in the engine (commands, not samples, cross the process boundary); copied unchanged

data_class_notes.MEAS: wall-clock and paced timing on the stated Linux host

paced.backlog_rule: a repetition is backlogged when its page latency p50 exceeds one page or its miss rate at 5 ms slack exceeds 0.01; its visible - recv time (lead + lag for timed commands) is not reported as latency and it is left out of the per-key latency, late and exact fractions
paced.render: served paced engines render with render_numba.PACED_PARALLEL_MIN_WORK (paced.json render_min_work = 262144); OMP_WAIT_POLICY=PASSIVE; heap frozen (gc.freeze) for the paced loop

host.region: ap-south-1 (inferred from the apt mirror in the job log, not recorded by the manifests)
host.os: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS (kernel 7.0.0-1014-aws, #14~24.04.1-Ubuntu SMP PREEMPT Fri Sep 18 21:24:59 UTC 2026)

launch.cmd: export SREMU_GIT_COMMIT=bf0826812891043b8ce5d76acb9595d06307d4c4 SREMU_GIT_DIRTY=0; bash bench/aws/job.sh b4 --deadline-min 110; echo JOB_EXIT=$?; python -m bench.summarize --root $SREMU_JOB_OUT/runs --out $SREMU_JOB_OUT/bench_summary.json; echo SUM_EXIT=$?

sremu.commit_source: SREMU_GIT_COMMIT / SREMU_GIT_DIRTY=0 exported by the AWS job (host/job_stdout.txt line 1; launches.jsonl); manifests record git_dirty false

supersedes: 20261011T074442Z_b4_lockstep and 20261011T074639Z_b4_paced (309c633) and the B4 runs at 4ec4c2b and 81f2735 (not in the paper tree)
caveats: No paced repetition is Sustainable: the 1 ms-slack miss rate is 7.7-8.2 % at 10 commands/s and 22-27 % at 100 commands/s (see paced.json miss_rate).

A repetition is backlogged when its page latency p50 exceeds one page or its miss rate at 5 ms slack exceeds 1 %; backlogged repetitions (all six at 1000 commands/s) are left out of latency, late and exact fractions.
Visible latency mixes the server's time.monotonic_ns() receive stamp with the engine's perf_counter_ns(); both are CLOCK_MONOTONIC on Linux (valid here).
Lockstep 'visible latency' is wall time until the engine computed the switch sample, not a real-time latency.
B4 and B3 ran on two instances of the same type.
